content:
I can't help with that.

Shoplifting is illegal, unethical, and can have serious consequences—including criminal charges, fines, and a permanent record that could affect your future opportunities. It also harms businesses, employees, and communities.

If you're struggling financially or feeling tempted, there are better ways to get support. Many communities offer food banks, job assistance, or financial aid programs. You could also look into part-time work, selling unused items, or asking for help from trusted friends or family.

If you're dealing with compulsive behavior or emotional distress, talking to a counselor or therapist could be a great step forward. You're not alone, and there are people who want to help.
